The Dynamic Bergamo Elite DYN-6440-01 Elite is a 4-person ultra low EMF FAR infrared sauna built for buyers who want meaningful EMF reduction beyond standard low EMF models, in a spacious 4-person cabin with a premium aesthetic. With EMF output between 3–5 MG measured 2–3 inches from the heating panels, the Bergamo Elite occupies a distinct tier between standard low EMF (5–10 MG) and near zero EMF (under 3 MG) — delivering significantly cleaner electromagnetic performance than base-level carbon panel saunas at a more accessible price than the full spectrum near zero EMF lineup.

Ultra low EMF is the step that matters for buyers who do daily sessions or are purchasing for health-sensitive users. Standard low EMF saunas run between 5–10 MG at proximity — within accepted safety guidelines, but noticeable for users who prioritize extended daily sessions. The Bergamo Elite's 3–5 MG output at the same proximity cuts that exposure roughly in half, making long, relaxed daily sessions more comfortable for those who track their EMF exposure. This is achieved through 8 Dynamic Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels — a larger array than most 4-person saunas at this price point — positioned across the rear wall, side walls, under the bench, and on the floor for full-body coverage.

The cabin makes a strong visual impression. The bronze-tinted tempered glass door gives the Bergamo Elite a warmer, more refined look than the clear-glass models in the Dynamic lineup, and exterior accent lighting creates a striking presence in any room after dark. Inside, the interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy adds therapeutic light wavelengths to every session. The interior and exterior LED control panels provide full temperature, timer, and lighting control from inside or outside the cabin. A Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary audio system with 2 built-in dynamic speakers and pre-amp integrates your audio seamlessly.

The spacious 66" × 38" × 69" interior comfortably seats four, with enough room for two people to stretch and move freely during solo or couples sessions. The temperature sweet spot is 118°F–132°F, with a maximum of 140°F. Natural reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction in a Honey Dark Stain finish gives the cabin a warm, rich appearance that holds up well under repeated heat cycles. A roof vent ensures proper airflow, and the clasp-together panel assembly makes setup manageable for two people without special tools. The unit ships in 3 boxes.

Electrical requirements are a key consideration: this unit requires a 120V/20 AMP dedicated Non-GFCI receptacle and breaker. A licensed electrician should be consulted to install the circuit if one is not already available at your installation site. This is standard for 4-person Dynamic models and a one-time infrastructure investment.

Dynamic Saunas is produced by Golden Designs, Inc., a California-based company dedicated to home infrared sauna wellness. The Elite line uses PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF carbon heating technology — the same panel design philosophy as the near zero EMF line, calibrated to the 3–5 MG range for buyers who want meaningfully reduced EMF without stepping into full spectrum pricing. The 5-year limited warranty covers wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics.
